<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(): return current_frame.ascii
def diff(b,a):
    H=len(a); Wd=len(a[0])
    return [(rr,cc,b[rr][cc],a[rr][cc]) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(Wd) if b[rr][cc]!=a[rr][cc]]
def piece_pos():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','c') and n['pixels']>=8:
            bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
# move piece right 1
b=snap()
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1}])
a=snap()
ch=diff(b,a)
print("after 1 right: changed",len(ch),"piece",piece_pos())
print("sample",ch[:10])
# move right 3 more
b=snap()
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1}]*3)
a=snap()
ch=diff(b,a)
print("after 3 more right: changed",len(ch),"piece",piece_pos())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
